decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
description:
Please read in conjunction with the provided TL 01 Nov 25- starting on the west boundary (Kitson Rd) and moving anti-clockwise to the south boundary (Church Rd) 
Tree no. 3 (Ash) - overhangs Kitson Road Hall- Reduce the northern side of the canopy to 5-6m from the trunk, and blend to the remaining crown, in height, and east and west sides. 
Tree Group, G1 (Hornbeam) - Crown lift to between 2.4-2.8m from ground level.
Tree No. 2 & 1 (Yew) - Crown lift to between 2.4-2.8m from ground level. Cut back 0.5m from the south side of tree no. 2's canopy for construction vehicle access. Cut back by 0.5m, the north side of tree no. 1's canopy for construction vehicle access.  
G5 -  Crown lift to between 2.4-2.8m from ground level.
Tree no. 36 - Crown lift to between 2.4-2.8m from ground level.
Tree Group, G4 - Crown lift to between 2.4-2.8m from ground level.

Southern boundary with tree nos. 31, 29, 28, 27, 20 & 19, and group nos. G3 and G4, including H2.
-	Trees along the south boundary outside of the site shall be crown lifted to between 2.4-2.8m, retaining boundary screening to and from public viewports
-	Crowns are to be pruned back to the inside line of the kerb along Church Road, retaining green screening and keeping interior browning of yews to an absolute minimum.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
